content.description: Automatic shift diagram showing throttle valve opening percentage vs output shaft rpm and vehicle speed for 'D' range 'PWR' pattern. Shows shift points for gears 1-2, 2-3, and 3-OD with both upshift (solid lines) and downshift (dashed lines). Differential gear ratio listed as 4.100.

Automatic shift diagram showing throttle valve opening percentage vs output shaft rpm and vehicle speed for '2' range. Shows shift points for gears 1-2 with both upshift and downshift patterns. Differential gear ratio listed as 4.100.

Automatic shift diagram showing throttle valve opening percentage vs output shaft rpm and vehicle speed for 'L' range 'NORM' pattern and 'PWR' pattern. Shows shift point for gears 1-2. Differential gear ratio listed as 4.100.
